title: Brighter plot lines and arrows
changes: **Clearer plots in dark mode:** lines, vector arrows, markers and their legend keys now use brighter colors across the lab, including native training charts. Arrows over contour maps also gain contrasting outlines. Try the [dot-product playground](/math_vectors) or [regression](/ml_regression).

**Consistent theme behavior:** Dark and Browser default use the brighter palette; Light and Color-blind safe retain their existing colors. Heatmaps, images and continuous color scales keep their original values and colors.

title: Consistent dark mode across the lab
changes: **Readable lessons in every track:** ANN, ML and Math diagrams now adapt their panels, labels and arrows to Dark and Browser default, while preserving their light appearance.

**Plots that fit your theme:** simulation backgrounds, axes, legends and annotations follow the selected theme. Heatmaps, image examples and their numeric color scales retain their original data colors.

**Clearer practice controls:** interactive chart labels, numeric tables, input borders, upload areas and navigation icons stay readable in dark mode. Chart interactions and table sorting remain available.

title: A timeline that follows your theme
changes: **Consistent About colors:** the author’s career timeline now uses your selected theme for its background, labels, connecting lines and milestones, including Dark, Browser default and Color-blind safe.

title: Clearer visit statistics
changes: **A cleaner About chart:** weekly visits now follow your selected theme, including dark and Browser default. The weekly table has been removed; hover over the chart for counts and coverage. Totals and daily averages remain above the graph.

title: Probability, optimization and honest evaluation
changes: **Three more guided foundations:** explore [probability and base rates](/math_probability), [optimization and convergence](/math_optimization), and [model evaluation](/ml_model_selection) with plain-language explanations, worked examples and 24 checked exercises with progressive hints.

**Predict, then investigate:** change spam rates to understand Bayes’ rule, compare learning rates on a quadratic, expose misleading accuracy, and choose a validation criterion before revealing a selected model’s test result. Save predictions and explanations in your notebook.

**A connected companion:** [Study Coach](/study_coach) includes the new Math and ML topics in recall questions, guided practice, derivations and progress-based recommendations. Existing saved work is preserved.

**About the lab:** the Home page’s About tab now shows weekly visits, recorded visits since 1 October 2026 and average visits per completed day, with clear counting and coverage notes. The 20 September updates are collected under one v1.13 entry in What’s new.

title: Guided Math and ML foundations
changes: **Four guided foundations:** learn [dot products](/math_vectors), [gradients](/math_calculus), [regression](/ml_regression) and [classification](/ml_classification) through plain-language explanations, worked numbers and interactive examples. Record predictions before revealing results.

**32 checked exercises:** practise calculations, common mistakes and small implementation choices with progressive hints, worked answers and five practice sets. Browser-saved results distinguish assisted solves from answers checked without hints or reveals.

**A companion for your track:** [Study Coach](/study_coach) now gives ML and Math their own recall questions, checked practice, derivations and next steps. [My learning](/my_learning) includes exercise results in its display and portable export, separately from self-assessed checkpoints.

title: Readable expandable sections
changes: **Dark-mode reading:** expandable headings now stay readable when opened, closed, hovered or focused with the keyboard. This applies to release history, lesson explanations, hints and worked solutions across the lab.

title: Readable dark mode
changes: **Clearer dark-mode controls:** buttons, module choices, menus, form fields and alerts now use contrasting text and dark backgrounds. Panels, tabs and keyboard-focus indicators are easier to see. The same improvements apply when Browser default follows a dark system theme.

title: Clearer language availability
changes: **EN and TR are visible in the language selector:** English is selected by default. Choosing TR keeps the English content and shows a Turkish notice at the top of Home explaining that translations are in progress.

title: English-only for now
changes: **Language availability:** the Turkish preview is temporarily disabled. Lessons, navigation, terms and feedback notices are currently shown in English.

title: Helping learners discover AI Lab
changes: **Search-engine discovery:** public learning pages now have a sitemap and crawler guidance to help search engines find the lab and its lessons.

title: A clearer release history
changes: **Updates for learners:** What’s new focuses on changes to lessons, exercises and the learning experience.

title: Reliable training journey links
changes: **Move between training lessons without an error:** the ANN and ML overview shortcuts now open regression, classification, neural-network and text-model lessons directly, including when the lesson belongs to another track.

title: Predict, rebuild and compare
changes: **A complete bilingual beginner path:** four short sessions connect [one neuron, learning an update, XOR and evaluation](/beginner_path), with numeric answers and implementation checks. Translation and human-review status are explicit.

**Record before running:** [bridge experiments](/bridge_lab), [debugging](/debugging_lab) and [evaluation challenges](/evaluation_lab) save your prediction and settings before revealing results. Add an explanation and compare runs in [My learning](/my_learning).
**Find the runnable exercise from the lesson:** direct links open the matching NumPy/PyTorch MNIST, attention, multihead or Transformer-block experiment. Quizzes now offer progressive hints.
**Clearer scope for every curriculum lesson:** specific simplifying assumptions, guide dates and human-review status appear alongside prerequisites and correction links.
**Reproducible deployment:** all production dependencies, including scikit-learn and indirect dependencies, are pinned to the tested Python 3.12 environment.

title: A more resilient public learning lab
changes: **Fair access to calculations:** shared computation limits and short training cooldowns help keep the lab responsive. If the lab is busy, a retry message explains when to try again.
**Stronger protection against automated probes:** sensitive-file requests are rejected before reaching the app, and excessive web requests receive a clear 429 response.
**Normal learning stays open:** lessons, notebooks and interactive experiments remain available, with browsing allowances designed for shared networks.

title: Follow what changes in the lab
changes: **What’s new is now on the homepage.** See the latest changes on Welcome and browse every release in the What’s new tab.
**Catch up on the learning tools:** try the [20-minute introduction](/start_here), [saved checkpoints and notebook](/my_learning), or [debugging challenges](/debugging_lab).
**Release notes stay with each update.** Every future deployment must include a new dated entry describing what changed.

title: A guided learning journey
changes: **Start here:** a [20-minute introduction](/start_here) to one neuron, in English and Turkish.
**Your learning, saved:** [checkpoints, bookmarks and a notebook](/my_learning) persist in your browser, with run comparisons and JSON export/import.
**A clearer next step:** the [Study Coach](/study_coach) uses your progress; lessons show goals, prerequisites and next steps.
**Practise before revealing answers:** predictions, quiz hints, [debugging](/debugging_lab) and [evaluation challenges](/evaluation_lab).
**Five new code experiments:** NumPy and PyTorch MNIST, single-head and multihead attention, and a Transformer block. Explore [Build the bridges](/bridge_lab); MNIST training runs locally.
**Fixes:** reliable direct lesson links and activation simulations that compute only the selected tab.

title: Step-by-step training labs
changes: Four new step-by-step training labs are now live: delivery-time regression, factory-failure classification, an XOR neural network, and a next-character text model. Each lets you inspect the same forward → loss → backward → update loop, follow one example, compare learning rates, and check results against held-out data or a baseline. The Turkish menu and selected interface labels are also being tested as an AI-generated preview; full, human-reviewed Turkish lesson translations are in progress. Please use English where accuracy matters.

title: The lab opens to everyone
changes: Initial release — the ANN track (single neuron → a small GPT), classical ML (M0–M8), Math foundations (X1–X6), worked numeric examples, an activation-functions deep dive, live playgrounds throughout, and this feedback form.
